content: Insurance agent Vikram Patel emailed customer Atharv Pandey following a earlier phone call to provide the renewal quote for Health Policy HP-785412, which expires today. The annual premium is $1,250, effective from September 30, 2026. The agent invited the customer to reply or call to process the renewal and avoid a lapse in coverage.

action_items: Reply to the email or call the agent to proceed with the renewal
